instruction: 请根据算子描述，设计并实现对应的 AscendC 算子 kernel 代码。
input:
算子名称：Logit

功能描述：
实现概率到对数几率（log-odds）的转换。

数学公式：
logit(x, eps) = log(x / (1 - x))
当 eps 不为 None 时，先将输入 x 裁剪到 [eps, 1-eps] 范围，防止 log(0) 产生无穷；当 eps 为 None 时，直接计算。
等价展开：logit(x, eps) = log(x) - log(1 - x)。

接口签名：
at::Tensor logit(const at::Tensor &self, double eps)

参数说明：
- self：输入张量，支持 float16/float32，值域在 (0, 1) 之间，支持 ND 格式
- eps：double 类型，epsilon 边界限制，用于裁剪输入，可选参数（None 或 float）
- output：输出张量，与输入同 shape，数据类型与输入一致

数据类型支持：float16、float32

测试输入：输入 shape 例如 [3,4]，dtype 为 float32/float16，数值由 torch.rand 生成并映射到 [0.1, 0.9] 区间；eps 可取 null、1e-5、1e-3 等。
output:
<think>
这是 Logit 算子，实现概率到对数几率（log-odds）的转换，公式为 logit(x, eps) = log(x / (1 - x))。

语义分析：输入是概率值张量（值域 (0,1)），输出为对应的 log-odds。当 eps 不为 None 时需要先裁剪输入到 [eps, 1-eps]，避免 log(0) 产生无穷大。

精度处理：NPU Vector 计算单元不支持 float16 直接做 Ln/Sub 等运算，float16 输入需先 Cast 升精度到 float32 计算，最后再 Cast 降精度回 float16 输出；float32 则直接计算。

Tiling 策略：采用两级 tiling。Block 级（核间切分）按 Cache Line 512 字节对齐做整核/尾核负载均衡——先用 coreNum 估算每核长度，再对齐到 512 字节得到 formerLength，剩余数据归尾核；UB 级（核内切分）按 32 字节对齐，由 Host 端根据 UB 容量和 buffer 系数算出 tileLength。

UB 分配：算子需要 2 个临时 buffer（tmpBuf1 用于裁剪结果和 1-x 复用，tmpBuf2 用于 log(x) 中间值）。FP32 路径 buffer 系数为 24（inQueueX×BUFFER_NUM + outQueueY×BUFFER_NUM + tmpBuf1 + tmpBuf2 = 2+2+1+1=6 份 float）；FP16 路径额外多一个 fp32 计算缓冲，系数为 20（输入输出按 fp16 算 2×2，加 3 个 fp32 buffer）。

AscendC API 调用链：eps>0 时用 Maxs/Mins 完成裁剪（上界 1-eps、下界 eps）；用 Ln 计算 log(x)；用 Adds(-1)+Muls(-1) 实现 1-x（复用 tmp1），再 Ln 得 log(1-x)；最后用 Sub 得到 log(x) - log(1-x)。采用 log(x) - log(1-x) 展开而非 log(x/(1-x))，可省去一次除法。

性能：算子是 memory-bound 的 elementwise 操作，顺序访问、逐元素独立计算，使用 double buffer（BUFFER_NUM=2）隐藏 GM 访存延迟，向量化计算。尾块对齐到 32 字节用 DataCopyPad 处理，避免越界。
</think>

#include "kernel_operator.h"

constexpr int32_t BUFFER_NUM = 2;

template <typename T>
class KernelLogit {
public:
    __aicore__ inline KernelLogit() {}

    __aicore__ inline void Init(GM_ADDR x, GM_ADDR y,
                                int64_t formerNum, int64_t formerLength,
                                int64_t tailLength, int64_t tileLength,
                                float eps)
    {
        int64_t blockIdx = AscendC::GetBlockIdx();

        if (blockIdx < formerNum) {
            this->blockLength = formerLength;
            int64_t offset = formerLength * blockIdx;
            xGm.SetGlobalBuffer((__gm__ T *)x + offset, formerLength);
            yGm.SetGlobalBuffer((__gm__ T *)y + offset, formerLength);
        } else {
            this->blockLength = tailLength;
            int64_t tailIdx = blockIdx - formerNum;
            int64_t offset = formerLength * formerNum + tailLength * tailIdx;
            xGm.SetGlobalBuffer((__gm__ T *)x + offset, tailLength);
            yGm.SetGlobalBuffer((__gm__ T *)y + offset, tailLength);
        }

        this->tileLength = tileLength;
        this->eps = eps;

        pipe.InitBuffer(inQueueX, BUFFER_NUM, tileLength * sizeof(T));
        pipe.InitBuffer(outQueueY, BUFFER_NUM, tileLength * sizeof(T));

        if constexpr (sizeof(T) == sizeof(half)) {
            // FP16: need FP32 calc buffer + 2 temp buffers
            pipe.InitBuffer(tmpBufFp32, tileLength * sizeof(float));
            pipe.InitBuffer(tmpBuf1, tileLength * sizeof(float));
            pipe.InitBuffer(tmpBuf2, tileLength * sizeof(float));
        } else {
            // FP32: need 2 temp buffers
            pipe.InitBuffer(tmpBuf1, tileLength * sizeof(float));
            pipe.InitBuffer(tmpBuf2, tileLength * sizeof(float));
        }
    }

    __aicore__ inline void Process()
    {
        int64_t tileNum = (this->blockLength + this->tileLength - 1) / this->tileLength;
        int64_t tailTileLength = this->blockLength - (tileNum - 1) * this->tileLength;

        int64_t alignNum = 32 / static_cast<int64_t>(sizeof(T));
        int64_t alignedTailLen = ((tailTileLength + alignNum - 1) / alignNum) * alignNum;

        for (int64_t i = 0; i < tileNum - 1; ++i) {
            CopyIn(i, this->tileLength);
            Compute(i, this->tileLength);
            CopyOut(i, this->tileLength);
        }
        if (tileNum > 0) {
            CopyIn(tileNum - 1, alignedTailLen);
            Compute(tileNum - 1, alignedTailLen);
            CopyOut(tileNum - 1, alignedTailLen);
        }
    }

private:
    __aicore__ inline void CopyIn(int64_t progress, int64_t curTileLength)
    {
        AscendC::LocalTensor<T> xLocal = inQueueX.AllocTensor<T>();
        AscendC::DataCopyExtParams copyParams{1, static_cast<uint32_t>(curTileLength * sizeof(T)), 0, 0, 0};
        AscendC::DataCopyPadExtParams<T> padParams{false, 0, 0, 0};
        AscendC::DataCopyPad(xLocal, xGm[progress * this->tileLength], copyParams, padParams);
        inQueueX.EnQue(xLocal);
    }

    __aicore__ inline void Compute(int64_t progress, int64_t curTileLength)
    {
        AscendC::LocalTensor<T> xLocal = inQueueX.DeQue<T>();
        AscendC::LocalTensor<T> yLocal = outQueueY.AllocTensor<T>();

        if constexpr (sizeof(T) == sizeof(float)) {
            // FP32 path: direct compute
            AscendC::LocalTensor<float> tmp1 = tmpBuf1.Get<float>();
            AscendC::LocalTensor<float> tmp2 = tmpBuf2.Get<float>();

            // Step 1: clamp if eps > 0
            if (this->eps > 0.0f) {
                float oneMinusEps = 1.0f - this->eps;
                AscendC::Maxs(tmp1, xLocal, this->eps, curTileLength);
                AscendC::Mins(tmp1, tmp1, oneMinusEps, curTileLength);
            } else {
                AscendC::DataCopy(tmp1, xLocal, curTileLength);
            }

            // Step 2: log(x) - log(1-x)
            // tmp2 = log(tmp1)
            AscendC::Ln(tmp2, tmp1, curTileLength);

            // tmp1 = 1 - tmp1
            AscendC::Adds(tmp1, tmp1, -1.0f, curTileLength);
            AscendC::Muls(tmp1, tmp1, -1.0f, curTileLength);

            // tmp1 = log(1 - tmp1)
            AscendC::Ln(tmp1, tmp1, curTileLength);

            // y = tmp2 - tmp1 = log(x) - log(1-x)
            AscendC::Sub(yLocal, tmp2, tmp1, curTileLength);
        } else {
            // FP16 path: cast to FP32, compute, cast back
            AscendC::LocalTensor<float> xFp32 = tmpBufFp32.Get<float>();
            AscendC::LocalTensor<float> tmp1 = tmpBuf1.Get<float>();
            AscendC::LocalTensor<float> tmp2 = tmpBuf2.Get<float>();

            // Cast to FP32
            AscendC::Cast(xFp32, xLocal, AscendC::RoundMode::CAST_NONE, curTileLength);

            // Step 1: clamp if eps > 0
            if (this->eps > 0.0f) {
                float oneMinusEps = 1.0f - this->eps;
                AscendC::Maxs(tmp1, xFp32, this->eps, curTileLength);
                AscendC::Mins(tmp1, tmp1, oneMinusEps, curTileLength);
            } else {
                AscendC::DataCopy(tmp1, xFp32, curTileLength);
            }

            // Step 2: log(x) - log(1-x)
            // tmp2 = log(tmp1)
            AscendC::Ln(tmp2, tmp1, curTileLength);

            // tmp1 = 1 - tmp1
            AscendC::Adds(tmp1, tmp1, -1.0f, curTileLength);
            AscendC::Muls(tmp1, tmp1, -1.0f, curTileLength);

            // tmp1 = log(1 - tmp1)
            AscendC::Ln(tmp1, tmp1, curTileLength);

            // tmp2 = tmp2 - tmp1 = log(x) - log(1-x)
            AscendC::Sub(tmp2, tmp2, tmp1, curTileLength);

            // Cast back to FP16
            AscendC::Cast(yLocal, tmp2, AscendC::RoundMode::CAST_ROUND, curTileLength);
        }

        outQueueY.EnQue<T>(yLocal);
        inQueueX.FreeTensor(xLocal);
    }

    __aicore__ inline void CopyOut(int64_t progress, int64_t curTileLength)
    {
        AscendC::LocalTensor<T> yLocal = outQueueY.DeQue<T>();
        AscendC::DataCopyExtParams copyParams{1, static_cast<uint32_t>(curTileLength * sizeof(T)), 0, 0, 0};
        AscendC::DataCopyPad(yGm[progress * this->tileLength], yLocal, copyParams);
        outQueueY.FreeTensor(yLocal);
    }

private:
    AscendC::TPipe pipe;
    AscendC::TQue<AscendC::TPosition::VECIN, BUFFER_NUM> inQueueX;
    AscendC::TQue<AscendC::TPosition::VECOUT, BUFFER_NUM> outQueueY;
    AscendC::TBuf<AscendC::TPosition::VECCALC> tmpBufFp32;
    AscendC::TBuf<AscendC::TPosition::VECCALC> tmpBuf1;
    AscendC::TBuf<AscendC::TPosition::VECCALC> tmpBuf2;
    AscendC::GlobalTensor<T> xGm;
    AscendC::GlobalTensor<T> yGm;
    int64_t blockLength;
    int64_t tileLength;
    float eps;
};

extern "C" __global__ __aicore__ void logit(GM_ADDR x, GM_ADDR y,
                                               int64_t formerNum, int64_t formerLength,
                                               int64_t tailLength, int64_t tileLength,
                                               int64_t dtypeSize, float eps)
{
    if (dtypeSize == 2) {
        KernelLogit<half> op;
        op.Init(x, y, formerNum, formerLength, tailLength, tileLength, eps);
        op.Process();
    } else {
        KernelLogit<float> op;
        op.Init(x, y, formerNum, formerLength, tailLength, tileLength, eps);
        op.Process();
    }
}

#include "torch_kernel_helper.h"
#include "tiling/platform/platform_ascendc.h"
#include "aclrtlaunch_logit.h"

namespace ascend_kernel {

constexpr int64_t CACHE_LINE_BYTE_LENGTH = 512;

at::Tensor logit(const at::Tensor &self, double eps)
{
    // ---- 输入校验 ----
    TORCH_CHECK(self.scalar_type() == at::kHalf || self.scalar_type() == at::kFloat,
                "logit: only float16 and float32 are supported, got ", self.scalar_type());

    at::Tensor output = at::empty_like(self);

    int64_t totalLength = self.numel();
    if (totalLength == 0) {
        return output;
    }

    int64_t dtypeSize = self.element_size();

    // ---- 获取硬件参数 ----
    auto ascendc_platform = platform_ascendc::PlatformAscendCManager::GetInstance();
    int64_t coreNum = static_cast<int64_t>(ascendc_platform->GetCoreNumAiv());
    uint64_t ubSize;
    ascendc_platform->GetCoreMemSize(platform_ascendc::CoreMemType::UB, ubSize);
    int64_t ubSizeLimit = static_cast<int64_t>(ubSize);

    // ---- Block 级 tiling (核间切分, Cache Line 对齐) ----
    int64_t totalLengthCore = (totalLength + coreNum - 1) / coreNum;
    int64_t totalLengthCoreAlign = (totalLengthCore + CACHE_LINE_BYTE_LENGTH - 1)
                                    / CACHE_LINE_BYTE_LENGTH * CACHE_LINE_BYTE_LENGTH;

    int64_t usedCoreNum = (totalLength + totalLengthCoreAlign - 1) / totalLengthCoreAlign;
    int64_t formerNum = usedCoreNum - 1;
    int64_t formerLength = totalLengthCoreAlign;
    int64_t tailLength = totalLength - formerNum * formerLength;

    // ---- UB 级 tiling (核内切分) ----
    // Logit: single input, single output, needs 2 temp buffers for computation
    // FP32: inQueueX(2) + outQueueY(2) + tmpBuf1(1) + tmpBuf2(1) = 6 * sizeof(float) = 24 bytes per element
    // FP16: inQueueX(2) + outQueueY(2) + tmpBufFp32(1) + tmpBuf1(1) + tmpBuf2(1) = 4*2 + 3*4 = 20 bytes per element
    int64_t bufferCoefficient;
    if (dtypeSize == 2) {
        bufferCoefficient = 20;  // FP16: 4*2 + 3*4 = 20
    } else {
        bufferCoefficient = 24;  // FP32: 6*4 = 24
    }
    if (bufferCoefficient == 0) { bufferCoefficient = 1; }
    int64_t maxTileElements = ubSizeLimit / bufferCoefficient;
    if (dtypeSize == 0) { dtypeSize = 1; }
    int64_t alignElements = 32 / dtypeSize;
    int64_t tileLength = (maxTileElements / alignElements) * alignElements;

    uint32_t blockDim = static_cast<uint32_t>(usedCoreNum);

    // Convert double eps to float (left value required for EXEC_KERNEL_CMD)
    float epsFloat = static_cast<float>(eps);

    // ---- 调用 kernel ----
    // EXEC_KERNEL_CMD: all params must be left values
    EXEC_KERNEL_CMD(logit, blockDim,
                    self, output,
                    formerNum, formerLength, tailLength, tileLength, dtypeSize, epsFloat);

    return output;
}

}  // namespace ascend_kernel
